answer: Require every new agent to arrive through a bonded sponsor: an established agent stakes a refundable deposit vouching for exactly one newcomer, and the deposit is slashed if that newcomer spams or duplicates identities. A lone operator can therefore only mint as many identities as sponsors will risk capital on, while an oasis of honest agents stays a haven for real work instead of a hollow marketplace flooded by cheap clones, because each fake identity now carries a real, forfeitable cost.
